our parish branch of the vocations society of st. joseph is currently seeking new members to join our community. what is the work of the society? the primary mission of the st. joseph’s young priests society is to foster vocations to the priesthood and religious life and to assist in the education of student priests bot h at home and in missionary lands. as a member, your involvement includes: prayer support: praying regularly for an increase in vocations and for the perseverance of seminarians and priests. financial assistance: contributing to the society’s fund, which directly aids student priests with the cost of their education and formation. building community: gathering monthly for prayer, discussion, and mutual support in our shared mission november remembrance mass: this year's november mass for those who have died during the year will take place on thursday november 12th at 7.30 pm . families of those who have died during the year are invited to participate in our remembrance mass. give your name/s in the

"a great cloud of witnesses": feast of all saints this november 1st on the feast of all saints, our parish is blessed to offer a unique encounter with the church universal. at our 11:30am mass , over 3,000 first-class relics of martyrs and saints will be displayed for public veneration. whether you have a devotion to a specific saint or simply wish to draw closer to the mysteries of heaven, we encourage you to join us for this prayerful occasion. let us gather together to venerate these holy relics and draw strength from the lives of the saints. fr. willie purcell -
